name: Ember Warden — example
author: dofus-lite authoring kit
description: An untested fire specialist illustrating ten authored spells. Medium-range pressure with limited escape and sustain. The mannequin and repeated placeholder icon are technical examples, not finished themed artwork.
credits: Character sheets: repository-generated technical mannequin from scripts/generate_character_templates.cjs. Icons: code-generated geometric placeholder. Existing client spell IDs are presentation references only; no client artwork is bundled.

design.identity: Wins by choosing when to hold medium range and when to spend a short boost window; struggles against fire resistance and sustained long-range pressure.
design.theme: A watchful keeper of embers: warm brass, ash and small deliberate flames. Final themed art has not been produced.
strengths: Reliable fire pressure without critical dependence.
A small group attack and a short push create positional choices.
weaknesses: All attacks deal fire damage, so fire resistance is a hard constraint.
Escape, healing and protection have downtime; there is no AP denial, summon, or long-range immunity.
turnLoop: Choose immediate attacks or invest 3 AP in Heat Focus.
Spend the boost window on attacks if the enemy remains reachable.
Recover position while the mobility, heal and burst cooldowns reset.
